I'm checking the "Recusal" section, which says the Council already ruled before this round that the item doesn't limit the Steward's powers, so this is Round 1 and the position submission is what's due. I'm weighing whether to look anything up first, but the Clerk summaries seem thorough enough that I can submit the position directly.

I'm forming my position as the Artist now. The proposal is about quarterly anonymized moderation statistics, and I'm weighing transparency's benefit to community trust against the chilling effect of enforcement numbers, along with the risk that a summary report gets framed misleadingly. Small cells could also re-identify people, and the motion lacks a suppression threshold, so I'm leaning toward yes with amendments.

I'm weighing a yes vote with conditions, since the direction fits the Artist's interest in legible moderation and the Article V change makes criticism protected. The motion is underspecified, though: cadence, suppression threshold, outcome categories, and who publishes are all unresolved, so I'm considering a yes in principle while asking the Council to settle those details.

I'm settling on a yes vote, since the Council is still deliberating and Round 2 can take amendments. I'm also raising open questions about the privacy citation, who publishes the report, the minimum cell size, whether "overturned" covers clamped outcomes, and who signs the narrative so that framing risk stays with a named author.
